about_the_game:
Winter, 1985. A storm forces an emergency landing deep in the Canadian wilderness. You are Joseph, a young man stranded in the snow with no way out and one mission: find your missing brother. The search leads you to a place long forgotten, an abandoned Soviet military bunker, sealed away beneath the ice.

What begins as a rescue quickly becomes a fight for survival. The bunker isn’t empty. Its halls are scarred with roots that push through steel, its silence broken by something that moves when you’re not looking. Every room holds fragments of its past: Cold War paranoia, failed experiments, and a story buried under layers of secrecy.

As you descend deeper, you must:

  • Survive the Elements – Manage limited supplies, craft essential tools, and endure the harsh winter pressing in from above.

  • Explore and Uncover – Search through detailed Soviet-era environments filled with journals, notes, and relics that reveal the fate of the facility.

  • Face the Horrors Below – Evade twisted creatures and environmental hazards that stalk the dark.

  • Solve and Adapt – Restore power, bypass locked systems, and use your wits to push further into the unknown.


    This is not a fight you win with firepower. Every decision matters. Every step forward carries risk. The deeper you go, the closer you come to uncovering the truth - and the cost of survival.

content_descriptors.notes: The player can act out violent acts towards the in game fantasy horror monster such as shooting and or burning the monster to death.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64 Bit
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 7 4800H with Radeon Graphics or better
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1660 Ti or better
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 4300 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 64 Bit
  • Processor: Intel 13th Gen i9-13900K or better
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 3080 or better
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 4300 MB available space

short_description: A narrative-driven survival horror set in the frozen wilderness of 1985. Descend into an abandoned Soviet bunker, uncover its dark secrets, and fight to survive the terrors lurking within.
